payload.title: Anyone can subscribe by email with double opt-in, and consent is recorded
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** As any reader, with no account, I subscribe to a site's new stories, confirm from my inbox, and leave whenever I like.

**Build.**
- Port the behaviour of Papyrus `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/` (`handler.py`, `confirmation.py`, `tokens.py`, `store.py`, `rate.py`): always answer `check_email`; honeypot and minimum fill time; a fresh nonce; 72-hour single-use confirm; GET confirm page then POST.
- Consent row `RCPT#<key>` / `CONSENT#<kind>`: requested and confirmed times, form id, page URL, exact wording, a keyed hash of the visitor address, or `migrated` with the source (S_MIGRATE).
- Abuse limits protect real things (SES reputation, other people's inboxes), so they stay; `rate.py` is the model. Limits are per visitor and per address, and limited requests still answer `check_email` and record a metric.

**Acceptance.**
Behave features; live confirm through a site page on Machines on Machines.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ff4727, kanbus-313b10, kanbus-1c3618

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Subscribe by email
  Scenario: Double opt-in
    When a reader subscribes to new stories on a site
    Then they see "check your email" and get one confirmation
    And they receive nothing else until they confirm

  Scenario: The answer reveals nothing
    Given an address that is already subscribed
    When someone subscribes it again
    Then they see the same "check your email"

  Scenario: Consent is kept
    When a reader confirms
    Then the time, the form, the page and the exact wording are recorded
```
